method.domain: >30 degree native shared hinges; at least one unique vertex in class0 96m band outside exact wet support, water/beach, reserve/platform; exclude 4/4 base-dry hinges
method.shoreline: XOR of actual wet status on two incident source triangles using nominal=max(P,0.85) and visible F per exact EV71 consumer
method.dry_support: vertices class0 and marked by exact wet support; support is preserved, dry side is potentially editable only when base eligible and no current fixed mask
method.flow_grouping: 8-connected raster components in combined cls {3,5,6}; spatial sector grouping only, not flow-physics proof
method.prominence: max signed dry non-support vertex height minus 5x5 terrain median; a screening metric, not a visual pyramid verdict

summary.focus_selection_rule: 3 spatially separated (>=300m) true wet/dry folds, distinct 8-connected flow components, at least 2 base-eligible dry nonsupport vertices not currently fixed, no reserve/platform/water/beach vertices; ranked by absolute dry nonsupport vertex prominence vs 5x5 median then angle. These are diagnostic candidates only.
